decisions.reason: The ceiling and floor pipe bracket is a low-cost addition close to the firm's core pipeline fabrication business and serves its existing plant builder and contractor customers.
The pipe support bracket complements the established pipeline component range and is cheap to keep in a growing industry.

The powder-coated public waste bin uses the firm's existing coating and steel fabrication capacity and sells to the same municipal customers, though it is distant from the core offer and its market traction is uncertain.
The waste bin with ashtray line shares production with the public waste bins and reaches municipalities, but as a multi-model line far from the core business it is more exposed to being streamlined.
The outdoor ashtray line diversifies the coating business toward municipal street furniture, but its niche demand and distance from pipeline products make a withdrawal plausible.
